title: Suburb and locality boundaries, Other Territories (Geoscape)
description:
The current boundary of every suburb and locality in the Other Territories, with its name and class, from Geoscape Administrative Boundaries, updated each quarter.

This is the 2026-08-17 version of this dataset on publicdata.au, with 6 rows and 6 fields. The same version is kept at https://publicdata.au/d/au-localities-ot/v/2026-08-17/ in 12 formats, with every earlier version and a query API. Each Zenodo version of this record is one publicdata.au version.

The data is published by Department of Industry, Science and Resources under CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. The licence requires this attribution:

Other Territories Suburb/Locality Boundaries - Geoscape Administrative Boundaries, sourced 3 October 2026, https://data.gov.au/data/dataset/other-suburb-locality-boundaries-geoscape-administrative-boundaries, licensed under CC BY 4.0.

This is an independent republication. The publisher has not endorsed this site.

The rows are in data.parquet, data.csv, data.json and data.xlsx. schema.json describes the fields, and publicdata.json names the version, licence, attribution and the SHA-256 of the publisher's file.
